title: Eric Davis helped write a book for Bigelow during AAWSAP

tellings.quote: During OAP, it turns out basically Davis was helping write that book at the time for BB.

plain: While working on a Pentagon-funded programme that studied UFOs and other strange phenomena from 2008, run through the company of the aerospace businessman Robert Bigelow, the physicist Eric Davis is said to have been helping write a book for Bigelow at the same time. The claim comes from a speaker identified only as Jack, on an episode with the Navy scientist Salvatore Pais, who puts it simply: "Davis was helping write that book at the time." The book is not named. It is told to show how closely the government work and Bigelow's private projects ran together.
